note: Files scripts/check_no_pii.py cannot read (binary content, or a compressed file it cannot decompress).
A scanner that cannot read a file reports it clean unless that file is listed here, so this file is the only
silence that is a verdict. Two registers, never mixed:
files         — REVIEWED. One person states what the file is and why it carries no personal or identifying
data (reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, sha256). Add one only after opening the file and
hashing the exact blob that will be committed; replace the blob and the exemption no longer
applies until the new content is reviewed.
grandfathered — FROZEN ENUMERATION of the 150 files already in the tree on 2026-11-05 when this gate landed.
They keep main green without claiming review. Nothing new may join: a pattern wide enough to
admit hero.png admits the next screenshot too, which is the defect this gate exists to stop.
Every path must exist in the gate-landing commit (--tree), the range base (--range) or HEAD
(--staged); a path that was not already there is refused. Removal is one-way — review a file
or delete it, then remove it here; the count and digest move with it, and a path that is both
reviewed and grandfathered fails the scan.
Every record pins sha256, the digest of the blob it was registered for: a changed binary is a finding until a
person reviews the new content. The enumeration asserts its own size (grandfathered_count) and digest
(grandfathered_sha256), so a deleted file, a smuggled path or a quietly enlarged list is a scan error, not a
Render with scripts/lib/ci_gates.render(); a test asserts this file is its canonical rendering.
